name: Stormbringer: Conductor In Charge raid damage does not stack (#3910)
contract: #3910: Conductor In Charge (300961) reads "Increases all damage dealt by party and raid members by $s1% and your Frost damage dealt by $s2%. Does not stack with similar effects." Spell.dbc row 92476 has Effect[0] = 65 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, MiscValue 127 (all seven schools), EffectBasePoints 2 + EffectDieSides 1 = 3, and Effect[1] = 6 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER with the same aura, MiscValue 16 (Frost), 4 + 1 = 5. Both halves are native: AuraEffect::HandleModDamagePercentDone accumulates them through Unit::GetTotalAuraMultiplierByMiscMask, which the spell_damage_done query reads via Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone. The non-stacking clause was not enforced, because no spell_group held 300961 or any of the eight other CoA raid damage auras, so two of them multiplied (1.03 x 1.03). The fix puts the nine ids in spell_group 2000184 with stack rule 3 and handles that group next to the other CoA raid groups in SpellMgr::IsEffectInSameEffectStackGroup, so only each spell's area-aura effect joins the group and the caster-only Frost effect keeps multiplying on its own. Carriers: Wrath (5176) is a Nature-school direct damage spell and Ice Lance (30455) a Frost-school one; neither is cast, they only carry the school through the native damage calculation from its fixed base of 1000.

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
Ally Nature damage before any raid damage aura
Stormbringer Nature damage before Conductor In Charge
Stormbringer Frost damage before Conductor In Charge
SETUP: the raid aura reaches the grouped ally
BASELINE: the ally deals 3% more Nature damage (EffectBasePoints[0] 2 + DieSides 1)
BASELINE: the caster's own Nature damage gains only the 3% raid effect
BASELINE: the caster's Frost damage gains 3% and 5% (1.03 x 1.05 = 1.0815)
SETUP: a second raid damage aura of the same family reaches the ally
DISCRIMINATING: two raid damage auras still give the ally 3%, not 1.03 x 1.03 = 1.0609
DISCRIMINATING: the caster keeps 1.03 x 1.05 = 1.0815 on Frost, neither 1.1139 (stacked) nor 1.05 (personal effect swallowed by the group)
